name: ct-login-idp-service
description: ChurchTools Identity Provider Service - Login UI + Azure Functions Backend

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run sync:env && npm run dev --workspace=@ct-login-idp-service/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run sync:env && cd packages/backend && dotnet run
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && cd packages/backend && dotnet clean
